fields.summary: Brand Manager: Determine Object Model, Record Creation, and Sharing Controls

fields.description:
## Outcome and context

Emily's feedback raised whether Brand Managers should see the Deal and Deal Rep Assignment (DRA) tied to a Rep, alongside signups. That question is now resolved: confirmed fine for a Brand Manager to see the Deal and DRA assigned to a Rep. This ticket implements that visibility.

## Current state

No sharing rule or visibility grant for Brand Managers into Deal or Deal Rep Assignment records exists yet — this depends on the Brand Manager object/record model being settled first (see Dependencies).

## Proposed solution

1. Once the Brand Manager object/record model is in place, extend sharing so a Brand Manager can view the Deal and Deal Rep Assignment records tied to the Reps (BAs) they manage.
2. Signup visibility for Brand Managers is treated as already agreed and is not blocked by this ticket — confirm it is included in whatever sharing rule gets built.

## Acceptance criteria

1. A Brand Manager can open and view the Deal and DRA records assigned to a Rep they manage.
2. A Brand Manager cannot see Deal/DRA records for Reps outside their management scope.
3. Signup visibility for Brand Managers is unaffected/confirmed working alongside this change.

## Dependencies

Depends on "Brand Manager: Determine Object Model, Record Creation, and Sharing Controls."

## Source

Wagertech Notes / Questions (Emily Vandenberg), reviewed Sep 2026: "Internal Question - for Brand Manager - we want them to see signups, but do we want them to see the DRA to the BA's — Confirmed fine for Brand Manager to see Deal and DRA assigned to a Rep." https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ShxHdE6kxblGnih7VQzXbBx1eL0sC6XAD-fk8H6V9yw/edit?tab=t.0
